question_cn: 2026世界杯K组小组赛（2026-06-23，休斯敦）：葡萄牙 vs 乌兹别克斯坦，90分钟三路赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group K (2026-06-23, Houston): Portugal vs Uzbekistan, three-way result after 90 minutes?
one_liner_cn: 葡萄牙实力、状态与大赛经验全面占优，约68%胜率；世界杯首秀的乌兹别克斯坦更可能死守求平而非爆冷取胜。
one_liner_en: Portugal hold a clear edge in strength, form, and experience at roughly 68% to win; debutants Uzbekistan are likelier to defend for a draw than to win outright.

key_reasons.cn: Elo差距275分（1989对1714），中立场Davidson模型给出葡萄牙约65.7%基准胜率
key_reasons.en: A 275-point Elo gap (1989 vs 1714) yields about a 65.7% baseline win probability for Portugal in the neutral-venue Davidson model

key_reasons.cn: 葡萄牙为欧国联卫冕冠军且状态出色，C罗伤愈于5月19日入选并任队长
key_reasons.en: Portugal are reigning Nations League champions in strong form, with Ronaldo recovered and named captain in the May 19 squad

key_reasons.cn: 乌兹别克斯坦世界杯首秀，26人中15人来自国内联赛，核心中卫库萨诺夫赛季出场有限、状态存疑
key_reasons.en: World Cup debutants Uzbekistan field 15 of 26 from the domestic league, and key centre-back Khusanov has sharpness doubts after an injury-curtailed season

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) on eloratings.net snapshot -> p_stat 65.7/20.8/13.5; bounded evidence adjustment +2.3pp to Portugal (form, full squad vs debutant inexperience and Khusanov fitness), renormalized. No betting or prediction-market data used.
